recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. If the Patient Care work group later wants richer List examples, that should be handled as a new source change to List examples or introductory text, not as a correction required by FHIR-11473.
issue_request: FHIR-11473 is a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking the clinical summary/List material to note that List is typically used with AllergyIntolerance and FamilyMemberHistory. Its resolution said to update the intro to note that List is used for allergy lists, family history, and medical history.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-11473 was found. The Jira comments record that no source edit was needed because List Scope and Usage already said "List resources are used in many places, including allergies, medications, alerts, family history, medical history, etc" and that Lloyd confirmed this on Zulip. Git blame and pickaxe history show that the key sentence was introduced before the issue in d72b1d787a and preserved through later refactors.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists list=List, so source/list/list-introduction.xml is in the current build. The clinical summary module already has allergy and family-history use cases for those resources; adding separate List prose there would duplicate the authoritative List resource guidance. FHIR-10662 is in the same medical-history family and likewise treated the existing List guidance as the relevant answer, while adding separate Condition-scope guidance. Indexed Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active List Scope and Usage already conveys the requested guidance, so no current source correction is required.
